neighbours.label: the discrete-versus-continuous distinction: the words discrete, discretize, discontinuous and continuous in a technical sense; near-synonyms like separate or distinct stay quiet
fire: In this model, time is treated as discrete steps of one second each.
The sensor outputs a continuous voltage that the chip later samples.
Many physical laws are written for continuous media such as fluids.
The equation was discretized on a mesh of ten thousand triangles.
Electrons in an atom can only occupy discrete energy levels.
The graph shows a discontinuity where the price suddenly jumps.
Unlike height, the number of children in a family is a discrete variable.
The motor runs on a continuous cycle without stopping for breaks.
quiet: In this model, time is treated as separate steps of one second each.
The sensor outputs a weak voltage that the chip later samples.
Many physical laws are written for simple media such as fluids.
The equation was solved on a computer in about ten minutes.
Electrons in an atom can only occupy certain energy levels.
The graph shows a sharp peak where the price suddenly jumps.
Unlike height, the number of children in a family is an individual choice.
The motor runs on a quiet cycle without stopping for breaks.
